title: How to Make AI Videos Look Like Real Camera Footage.
description: This looks like real camera footage, but it’s completely AI. The secret isn’t the tool—it’s the workflow: choose the right model, prompt like a filmmaker, then add natural film texture to hide AI artifacts.
